elements.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 still grants HDI the exclusive right to use the “Deerskin” brand for a self-contained consumer website offering Deerskin Products, thereby restricting the Company in that field of use.

elements.element: The restriction covers only a named competing product.
elements.evidence: The exclusivity covers the defined category “Deerskin Products,” not only a named competing product.

elements.element: The restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: The exclusive right is an obligation under the Agreement, and no post-termination survival language is supplied; therefore it applies only while the Agreement remains in effect.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: Although the initial term is one year, Section 4.1 provides automatic one-year renewals without an overall 12-month cap.

elements.element: The restriction permits Customer's internal development.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no carve-out permitting the Company’s internal development.
The rendered language contains no carve-out for acquisitions by the Company.
